patch_description:
I restructure the ansatz block to explicitly encode tic-tac-toe geometric motifs while keeping parameter efficiency. Key changes:
- Replace the fixed CZ backbone with trainable CRZ entangling gates (ring vs spokes) so entanglement strengths are learned.
- Introduce dedicated three-qubit ZZZ motifs split by row/column/diagonal (zzz_row, zzz_col, zzz_diag) to encourage line-detection patterns.
- Add doubly-controlled RZs (CCRZ) focused on center-involving winning lines (ccrz_center).
- Use lightweight, symmetry-grouped single-qubit rotations (pre/post RZ and RY) but keep groups (corner/edge/center) to reduce parameter count and encourage inductive priors.
- The block has 13 unique parameter keys -> with N_UPLOADS=3 and N_REPEATS=2 this yields 78 total tunable parameters (similar to high-performing prior candidates), balancing expressivity and efficiency.

Expected improvements: the motif-aligned triples + trainable CRZ backbone should improve test/validation accuracy and reduce the train-test gap while keeping parameter efficiency high.
